about: npm itself (the unchanged npm 11.12.1 CLI, pinned in the app) publishing and installing a package through the World's registry, as cookbook/tabnode's seed.mjs and the catalog's release publish theirs: npm publish with the token the credential door issues as NPM_TOKEN on the registry the World names in NPM_REGISTRY_TWIN_URL, npm view reading the version document and its tarball's integrity, npm dist-tag ls reading the channels (the update check Volter Harness makes), and a consumer's npm install whose lockfile pins the published tarball and whose code runs. The readback, after the World resumes, reads the release again and installs the same bytes into a new consumer, each npm run with a fresh cache so every read reaches the registry.

files.glaze/index.js:
// Scales a glaze recipe (ingredient: percent of the dry batch) to grams for a batch of the given dry weight.
exports.scale = (recipe, grams) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(recipe).map(([name, percent]) => [name, Math.round(percent * grams) / 100]));
